name: check_order
description: Look up the status of a customer order by its order ID (for example ORD-123 or 123). Returns the current status (processing, shipped, delayed, delivered), the item, the estimated delivery date, and a delay reason when the order is delayed. Use this to answer questions like 'Why is my order 123 delayed?'.

order_id.description: The order ID to look up (for example ORD-123).
